kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستأصل (form X)
# أَسْتَأْصِلُ (ʔastaʔṣilu) /ʔas.taʔ.sˤi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْصَلَ (istaʔṣala)
# أُسْتَأْصَلُ (ʔustaʔṣalu) /ʔus.taʔ.sˤa.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْصَلَ (istaʔṣala)
# أَسْتَأْصِلَ (ʔastaʔṣila) /ʔas.taʔ.sˤi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْصَلَ (istaʔṣala)
# أُسْتَأْصَل
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
